PURPOSE.one_line: Derive the narrowest executable authority capable of establishing the owner-ratified QUIESCE posture for the governed staging pre-DDL recovery window, or STOP with an explicit capability gap if no current mechanism can prove it.
what_this_artifact_is_not: It is not an execution grant. Nothing here may be executed until it is independently certified and a future execution lane opens with its own prestate, freshness gate and human confirmations.
It does not authorize a backup, a restore, any DDL, any Stage-A application, or any production operation.
It does not edit, supersede or reinterpret the Recovery authority, its amendment, the owner-ratification record, or PR #201.
It does not allocate any ODS ordinal, HPO-ODS grant id, migration ordinal or Controller entry.

SECTION_B_QUIESCE_SCOPE_ADJUDICATION.question: Does Recovery OD-3 require (1) only the PR #201-bound web runtime to become non-writing, or (2) every writer capable of reaching the staging database to be quiesced?
SECTION_B_QUIESCE_SCOPE_ADJUDICATION.verdict: OPTION 2. The predicate is a property of the DATABASE, not of one client.

grounds.ground: The parent authority states the PURPOSE of the posture, and the purpose is database-scoped.
grounds.quoted: The execution lane MUST establish the no-intervening-mutation predicate POSITIVELY rather than assume it.
grounds.reading: The predicate is 'no intervening mutation OF THE TARGET'. A mutation by GoTrue, by the dashboard SQL editor, or by a second preview deployment is lost on restore in exactly the same way and to exactly the same extent as a mutation by the bound runtime. A posture that leaves those writers untouched does not establish the predicate; it establishes a weaker, differently-named proposition.

grounds.ground: The owner's own ratification text is scoped to STAGING WRITES, not to the runtime's writes.
grounds.quoted: For the governed pre-DDL recovery window, staging writes must be quiesced so that the no-intervening-mutation predicate can be established positively.
grounds.reading: The object of 'quiesced' is 'staging writes'. The runtime is not named in the operative sentence.

grounds.ground: The narrower reading is available only by treating an ILLUSTRATION as a LIMIT.
grounds.measured: The phrase 'the bound runtime' appears in OWNER_DECISIONS.decisions[OD-3].decision, in a sentence that is offering the owner a choice between two postures. The surrounding block, THE_LIVE_RUNTIME_COMPLICATION, introduces the bound runtime as the reason the complication EXISTS — 'PR #201 authored the runtime staging binding, and a bound runtime issues application writes'. It is the worked example that motivated the question, not an enumeration of the writers the answer covers.
grounds.reading: Reading the example as the limit would mean the authority silently exempted every writer it had not happened to think of. That is the opposite of how its own fail_closed clause reads.

grounds.ground: The fail-closed clause forbids the narrow reading directly.
grounds.quoted: If neither posture is established, S8 is NOT satisfied. An unproven no-mutation claim is not a confirmation.
grounds.reading: A claim that the database did not mutate, supported only by evidence about one of sixteen writer classes, is an unproven no-mutation claim.

SECTION_B_QUIESCE_SCOPE_ADJUDICATION.explicitly_rejected_reasoning: Option 1 is cheaper, is closer to the literal words of one sentence, and would let this lane hand back a tidy mechanism. The lane brief forbids narrowing owner intent because option 1 is easier, and this adjudication does not do so. Option 1 is rejected on SB-1 and SB-4, which are properties of the predicate, not of the cost.
SECTION_B_QUIESCE_SCOPE_ADJUDICATION.consequence_the_owner_bears: Option 2 is materially more expensive than option 1 and may be unreachable by prevention alone. That consequence is carried forward honestly into SECTION_C and surfaced as owner decision OD-Q1 rather than absorbed silently.
SECTION_B_QUIESCE_SCOPE_ADJUDICATION.this_is_not_a_third_posture: The parent offered exactly two postures, QUIESCE and ACCEPT, and the owner selected QUIESCE. This section decides the SCOPE of the selected posture. It does not create a third.

SECTION_C_CANDIDATE_MECHANISMS.method: Each mechanism is assessed against the SECTION_A inventory under the SECTION_B scope. A mechanism is REJECTED if it cannot prove the property it claims, even where it genuinely reduces risk.

mechanisms.mechanism: ORDERING / ABSTENTION — place the entire recovery window BEFORE PR #201's AUTH-1 and AUTH-2 execute, so that no bound runtime exists during it.
mechanisms.prevents: W-1 entirely, and with it W-2 and the whole of W-3, because Server Actions and route handlers have no network identity apart from the runtime that serves them.
mechanisms.mutation_required: NONE. Abstention is not an act.
mechanisms.evidence_available: Read-only control-plane enumeration: no branch-scoped Preview binding exists for the three PR #201 variables on integration/commercial-v1, and no deployment's runtime-identity endpoint reports the governed staging ref. PR #201's own PMV-3 already defines the first of these checks.
mechanisms.rollback: Not applicable — nothing is changed, so nothing is restored. The posture ends when PR #201 is permitted to execute.
mechanisms.blast_radius: ZERO on the hosted plane. The cost is purely schedule: PR #201's D-1 measurement is deferred until the window closes.
mechanisms.interaction_with_PR201: ORDERING DEPENDENCY, stated explicitly in SECTION_F. M-1 consumes none of PR #201's authority and does not reinterpret it; it only constrains WHEN that authority may be exercised.
mechanisms.verdict: ACCEPTED as the narrowest available reduction. NOT SUFFICIENT ALONE, because it addresses three of sixteen writer classes.

mechanisms.mechanism: Application-level maintenance / read-only mode inside the Next.js runtime.
mechanisms.prevents: W-2 and W-3, if correctly implemented and correctly deployed.
mechanisms.does_not_prevent: W-4 through W-7, W-10 through W-12, W-14 through W-16. Critically, it does not prevent W-4, because GoTrue is reached directly and never traverses the application.
mechanisms.mutation_required: A repository code change AND a deployment.
mechanisms.evidence_available: Weak. A 503 from an application endpoint proves that endpoint refused; it proves nothing about any path that does not pass through it.
mechanisms.rollback: A second code change and a second deployment.
mechanisms.blast_radius: Introduces new code onto the exact surface whose behaviour is being certified.
mechanisms.interaction_with_PR201: HOSTILE. PR #201 grants EXACTLY ONE deployment under a bounded retry whose conditions are conjunctive. Spending it on a maintenance-mode build would consume the scarce act that exists to measure D-1, and PR #201 explicitly does not authorize any repository code change.

mechanisms.mechanism: Supabase database network restrictions — narrowing the allowed CIDR set.
mechanisms.prevents: Direct PostgreSQL connections from outside the platform: W-1's driver connections, W-12 and W-15.
mechanisms.does_not_prevent: W-4, W-5, W-6, W-7. GoTrue, PostgREST, Storage and Realtime run INSIDE the platform network and do not traverse the database's external network restrictions. Also does not prevent W-16, which reaches the database through the platform.

mechanisms.interaction_with_PR201: PR #201's not_authorized list contains 'ANY Supabase configuration mutation of any kind' verbatim. The Recovery authority does not authorize one either.

mechanisms.mechanism: Database role or ACL change — ALTER ROLE ... NOLOGIN, REVOKE on the application role, or ALTER DATABASE ... SET default_transaction_read_only = on.
mechanisms.does_not_prevent: Sessions ALREADY OPEN at the moment of the change. NOLOGIN prevents new authentication; it does not terminate an established session. default_transaction_read_only is a default, overridable per-transaction by any role that can SET it, and does not apply to already-started transactions.
mechanisms.fatal_objection_1: Reaching W-4 through W-7 would require revoking the roles GoTrue, PostgREST and Storage authenticate as, which disables the platform services themselves rather than quiescing them — and is a mutation of provider-managed roles.
mechanisms.fatal_objection_2: It is a privileged database mutation. This lane's mode forbids any database connection, the Recovery authority does not authorize DML or DDL, and inserting such a permission here would be exactly the silent authority expansion the owner record already refused to commit once.
mechanisms.verdict: REJECTED. Requires database authority this chain does not hold, is not total against open sessions, and cannot reach the provider services without breaking them.

mechanisms.fatal_objection: SELF-DEFEATING. A paused project cannot serve the pg_dump that the quiesce exists to protect. The mechanism destroys the act it is meant to make safe.

mechanisms.mechanism: Disabling the Data API or Auth signups through project settings.
mechanisms.objections: A Supabase configuration mutation outside every held authority; disabling signups does not stop token refresh, password reset or session writes, which are the bulk of W-4's traffic; and no atomic 'disable Auth' control is asserted to exist, because this lane performed no live reads.

mechanisms.mechanism: A dedicated maintenance deployment serving a static page.
mechanisms.prevents: Nothing that M-2 does not, and requires a second deployment PR #201 does not grant.
mechanisms.verdict: REJECTED. Strictly dominated by M-2, which is itself rejected.

mechanisms.mechanism: DATABASE-SIDE NEGATIVE WITNESS — do not attempt to prevent every writer; instead prove, from inside the database, that NO write transaction occurred across the window, and VOID the window if one did.
mechanisms.prevents: NOTHING. This is deliberately not a prevention mechanism.
mechanisms.proves: The predicate itself, totally and writer-agnostically. PostgreSQL assigns a transaction id only to a transaction that actually writes; read-only transactions never consume one. A pair of read-only observations of the database's transaction-id frontier, taken at the two boundaries of the window, therefore answers 'did ANYTHING write in this interval' without needing to know, enumerate, or control WHO would have written.
mechanisms.why_this_reaches_what_no_prevention_mech: W-4, W-14 and W-16 are unreachable by any control this chain holds. They are NOT unreachable by observation. A write by GoTrue advances the frontier exactly as a write by the bound runtime does. The witness does not care which of the sixteen classes acted.
mechanisms.mutation_required: NONE. Both observations are read-only and neither consumes a transaction id.
mechanisms.evidence_available: Two machine-comparable scalar observations plus their timestamps, recorded in the evidence packet. Equality is the PASS condition; inequality is a VOID verdict.
mechanisms.blast_radius: ZERO on the hosted plane. Two read-only queries on a connection the backup step already opens.
mechanisms.known_conservatism: Autovacuum and anti-wraparound freezing consume transaction ids without any user DML. The witness can therefore report movement when no business data changed. This is a FALSE POSITIVE, never a false negative: it can declare a clean window void, and it can NEVER declare a dirty window clean. The direction of error is the fail-closed one and the mechanism is accepted with it, not despite it. See OD-Q2.
mechanisms.interaction_with_PR201: NONE. It touches no Vercel surface.
mechanisms.requires_db_or_ddl_authority: It requires a READ on a connection that AO-3 already opens. It requires no DDL, no DML and no privileged role. It is nonetheless NOT among AO-1..AO-9, and is therefore the narrow permission this artifact exists to derive.
mechanisms.verdict: ACCEPTED as the PROOF. Paired with M-1 as the reduction.

SECTION_D_PREFERRED_MECHANISM.adjudication: M-1 (ORDERING / ABSTENTION) as the RISK REDUCTION, plus M-11 (DATABASE-SIDE NEGATIVE WITNESS) as the PROOF. Neither alone is sufficient; together they establish the predicate that OD-3 requires, under the SECTION_B scope, with ZERO hosted mutation.

the_reframe_that_makes_this_possible.the_trap: The lane brief asks for a mechanism that makes the write-capable surfaces non-writing. Taken literally, that is unachievable: SECTION_A measures at least three writer classes (W-4, W-14, W-16) that no authority in this chain can reach, and six more that are UNKNOWN and fail closed. Pursued literally, this lane STOPS with an unbounded capability gap.
the_reframe_that_makes_this_possible.the_distinction: What OD-3 actually requires is not that the writers be disabled. It is that the NO-INTERVENING-MUTATION PREDICATE be established POSITIVELY. Disabling writers is one way to argue for that predicate — and a weak one, because it still requires proving the disablement was total and held.
the_reframe_that_makes_this_possible.the_consequence: Prevention can never be proven total against an inventory containing UNKNOWNs. Observation of the database's own write frontier IS total by construction, because it is indifferent to which writer acted. The bounded problem 'detect whether anything wrote' replaces the unbounded problem 'prove every writer is disabled'.
the_reframe_that_makes_this_possible.why_this_is_not_a_weakening: Under M-11 no write in the window is ever accepted as lost. If the witness moves, the window is VOID, the recovery point is discarded and no restore is performed against it. The owner's refusal of ACCEPT is honoured strictly: ACCEPT tolerates lost writes, DETECT-AND-VOID tolerates none. It lands strictly inside QUIESCE's guarantee, and is therefore not the third posture the owner record forbids.

SECTION_D_PREFERRED_MECHANISM.why_not_a_bare_capability_gap: The lane brief instructs a STOP with a minimum implementation if no current mechanism can prove quiescence. No PREVENTION mechanism can. M-11 is an OBSERVATION mechanism that can, it requires no new capability, no new code and no hosted mutation, and it is available to the execution lane on the connection AO-3 already opens. Declaring a capability gap while a zero-cost total proof is available would be a failure to look, not a fail-closed.
SECTION_D_PREFERRED_MECHANISM.what_remains_genuinely_gapped: M-11 proves the predicate. It does NOT reduce the PROBABILITY that the predicate fails. A window that is voided repeatedly because W-4 keeps writing is a real operational failure mode that M-1 only partially mitigates. Closing that is a prevention problem and it remains open — see SECTION_K and OD-Q3.

SECTION_E_PROOF_OF_QUIESCENCE_CONTRACT.status: This contract is DERIVED here and is NOT EXECUTABLE until independently certified. It also closes IG-2, which recorded that no artifact in the chain specified a quiesce-attestation shape.
SECTION_E_PROOF_OF_QUIESCENCE_CONTRACT.machine_verifiable_requirement: Every PQ below resolves to a recorded value, a comparison, or an explicit UNKNOWN. No PQ is satisfied by prose.

contract.requirement: THE WINDOW BEGINS at the instant the logical backup's snapshot is established — not at the instant the operator decides to start.
contract.why: The recovery point IS the snapshot. Anything written before the snapshot is inside the backup and is not lost. Anchoring the window to an operator's clock would either shorten it fictitiously or lengthen it needlessly.
contract.recorded: W0 = the negative witness observed in the SAME transaction that establishes the dump snapshot, plus its wall-clock timestamp.

contract.requirement: THE WINDOW ENDS at the instant immediately before the first DDL statement of the recovery/Stage-A work is issued.
contract.recorded: W1 = the negative witness observed immediately before that statement, plus its wall-clock timestamp.
contract.note: The window is [snapshot, pre-DDL]. Writes AFTER the DDL begins are governed by the DDL's own authority, not by this contract.

contract.requirement: THE PASS CONDITION is W1 == W0 on the transaction-id frontier. Any inequality is a VOID verdict.
contract.on_void: The recovery point is DISCARDED. No restore is performed against it. The window may be re-attempted from a fresh backup under a fresh confirmation. A VOID window is never converted into an ACCEPT by rationalising the observed movement — that conversion would silently deliver the posture the owner refused.
contract.fail_closed: If either witness is missing, unreadable, or of unknown provenance, the verdict is VOID, not UNKNOWN.

contract.requirement: THE WITNESS IS READ-ONLY AND MUST NOT ITSELF CONSUME A TRANSACTION ID.
contract.constraint: The observation must be taken by a function that reports the frontier without allocating one. A call that allocates an id on each observation would make W1 != W0 unconditionally and render the contract vacuous.
contract.verification: The execution lane must demonstrate, on the disposable PostgreSQL harness at the SAME engine build as staging, that two consecutive observations across a genuinely idle interval return EQUAL values. A witness that never reports equality proves nothing.
contract.engine_build_note: The exact hosted engine build is a named dependency of this verification. A witness validated on a different major version is not validated for staging.

contract.requirement: WRITER DISPOSITION TABLE. Every writer class W-1..W-16 carries an explicit disposition at W0: PREVENTED, ABSENT, OUT_OF_REACH_BUT_WITNESSED, or UNKNOWN.
contract.why_it_is_still_required_when_the_witnes: The witness proves the outcome; the table proves the lane understood the exposure it was accepting. A void window with no table is an incident with no diagnosis. It is also what makes MG-Q1 and MG-Q2 visible rather than buried.
contract.UNKNOWN_rule: UNKNOWN is permitted in this table ONLY for classes the witness covers. It is NEVER permitted as a disposition for the witness itself.

contract.requirement: DELAYED AND RETRIED WORK MUST BE DECLARED, because it can write AFTER the window using state from BEFORE it.
contract.measured_instance: app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts returns 503 for every refusal reason, and its own source states this is deliberate because Stripe abandons delivery after a 2xx. An event delivered during the window is therefore RETRIED after it. At this tree the handler is a non-writer by source constant, so no write results; at a tree where that constant is true, a post-window write carrying pre-window state does result.
contract.contract: The lane must state, for each retrying external producer, whether a delivery suppressed during the window can write after it. Silence is not a declaration.

contract.requirement: DATABASE SESSIONS ALREADY OPEN AT W0 DO MATTER, and must be enumerated.
contract.grounds: A session established before the window can write inside it. Two measured properties of this stack make the naive assumptions wrong: rotating or changing a credential does NOT terminate an established session, and a NOLOGIN or read-only default does not reach a session or transaction already started.
contract.contract: At W0 the lane records the count of non-idle sessions not belonging to the backup itself. A non-zero count is not automatically a VOID — the witness decides that — but it MUST be recorded, because it is the leading indicator of a window that is about to void.
contract.feasibility: pg_stat_activity is visible to a non-superuser for its own sessions and, on this provider's image, more broadly. The exact visibility is a property of the role the execution lane connects as and must be stated, not assumed.

contract.requirement: IN-FLIGHT REQUESTS ARE NOT ADDRESSED BY ANY BARRIER, AND THIS MUST NOT BE PAPERED OVER.
contract.statement: A request that passed an application barrier microseconds before that barrier engaged completes normally. No maintenance page, no env removal and no deployment deletion changes this. Under M-11 it does not need to: such a write advances the frontier and voids the window, which is the correct outcome.
contract.explicit: A MAINTENANCE PAGE IS NOT PROOF. It is not accepted as evidence for any PQ in this contract, alone or in combination.

contract.requirement: THE RESUMPTION BOUNDARY IS AN EXPLICIT ACT, NOT AN EXPIRY.
contract.statement: Writes resume only when a separately confirmed reversal act occurs — under M-1, that is the moment PR #201 is permitted to execute. A window does not end because time passed.

contract.requirement: THE ATTESTATION IS A SINGLE ARTIFACT containing: W0, W1, both timestamps, the PQ-3 verdict, the PQ-5 disposition table, the PQ-6 declaration, the PQ-7 session count, the target ref bvyzblhqymxruxdguaee, and the identity of the exact commit whose writer inventory was used.
contract.prohibition: The attestation carries NO credential, NO DSN, NO token and NO environment-variable value. It carries refs and identifiers only.

what_this_contract_deliberately_does_not: It does not claim any writer was prevented. Under M-11 only W-1..W-3 are prevented, and only by abstention.
It does not claim the hosted provider-service surfaces were disabled. They were not, and W-4's exposure is UNKNOWN at this ref.
It does not claim the witness is sensitive only to business writes. It is not; see M-11.known_conservatism.

SECTION_J_OWNER_DECISIONS.separation_rule: An owner decision is a question whose answer is a cost the owner bears, not a fact an engineer can measure. Nothing below is an engineering inconvenience dressed as a decision.

decisions.question: Does the ratified QUIESCE posture cover only the PR #201-bound runtime, or every writer capable of reaching governed staging?
options: B: every writer capable of reaching the database.
decisions.measured_consequences: Under A, the predicate is asserted while at least three measured writer classes (W-4 GoTrue, W-14 other Vercel bindings, W-16 the dashboard) and six UNKNOWN classes remain free to write, so a restore can silently lose writes the owner believed were protected. Under B, the predicate is real, but SECTION_C measures that no PREVENTION mechanism can deliver it and the proof must be M-11's witness, which can void a window on autovacuum alone.
decisions.recommendation: B. SECTION_B adjudicates B on the authority's own text, and A would deliver a posture named QUIESCE that does not do what the owner bought the staging outage for.
decisions.what_remains_blocked_until_answered: The PQ-5 disposition table's scope, and therefore the whole proof contract.
decisions.why_not_engineering: A is cheaper and faster. Choosing between a cheaper posture and a stronger one is the owner's call, not the author's.

decisions.question: Does the owner accept a CONSERVATIVE witness that can declare a window VOID even when no business data changed?
options: A: accept — a void window is re-attempted from a fresh backup.
B: reject — require a witness that distinguishes user DML from autovacuum.
decisions.measured_consequences: Under A, the failure mode is repeated windows and operator time; the predicate is never weakened. Under B, no such witness is currently specified, the capability gap reopens, and execution is blocked until one is built and validated on the exact hosted engine build.
decisions.recommendation: A. The conservatism errs fail-closed: it can call a clean window dirty, never a dirty window clean.
decisions.why_not_engineering: The cost is the owner's operator time and schedule, not a technical property.

decisions.question: Does the owner accept that, under the preferred mechanism, the provider-side writers are DETECTED rather than PREVENTED?
options: A: accept detect-and-void as the implementing mechanism of QUIESCE.
B: require prevention of every writer before any window opens.
decisions.measured_consequences: Under A, no write is ever accepted as lost — a detected write voids the window — so the owner's refusal of ACCEPT is honoured strictly, with zero hosted mutation. Under B, SECTION_C measures that no available mechanism prevents W-4, W-14 or W-16, so B is a STOP with an unbounded capability gap requiring new Supabase-plane authority and probably new provider capability.
decisions.recommendation: A, with the honest caveat that A does not reduce the PROBABILITY of a void, only guarantees its detection.
decisions.what_remains_blocked_until_answered: The entire SECTION_D adjudication, and therefore any execution lane.
decisions.why_not_engineering: A and B deliver the same guarantee about lost writes and differ in operational cost and in how much residual exposure the owner is willing to hold. That is the owner's to weigh.
decisions.not_a_third_posture: See SECTION_D.the_reframe_that_makes_this_possible.why_this_is_not_a_weakening. A tolerates no lost write and is therefore inside QUIESCE, not beside it.

decisions.question: Which executes first, the recovery window or PR #201?
options: A: the recovery window first — PR #201's D-1 measurement is deferred.
B: PR #201 first — the window then runs against a live bound runtime.
decisions.measured_consequences: Under A, W-1, W-2 and the whole of W-3 are absent by construction and the window's probability of voiding is materially lower, at the cost of deferring D-1. Under B, D-1 lands sooner and every window thereafter carries the bound runtime's live write traffic, raising the void rate and making repeated windows likely.
decisions.recommendation: A. It is the only ordering under which the reduction half of the preferred mechanism exists at all.
decisions.what_remains_blocked_until_answered: DEP-1, and the scheduling of both lanes.
decisions.why_not_engineering: Deferring a measurement the programme wants is a schedule cost the owner bears.

decisions_NOT_claimed_as_owner_decisions: Whether M-2, M-3, M-5, M-6, M-7, M-8, M-9 or M-10 is viable. These are REJECTED on measured grounds in SECTION_C and are not offered to the owner as choices.
Whether the witness must be read-only. That is a correctness property (PQ-4), not a preference.
Whether a maintenance page can serve as proof. It cannot (PQ-8), and no owner ratification would make it one.
